digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, transition, etc.)
propositions: Mutating verbs currently exit silently on success, making it indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, forcing agents to issue follow-up store reads to verify writes.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a single kubectl-style confirmation line on stdout describing the state change (e.g. 'linked X -> Y'), with 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent paths.
Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch, working uniformly across all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves.

Existing consumed seam returns (e.g. add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract) and link's REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical; confirmations print only in text mode, with JSON output as a structured envelope field.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving all existing data, and consumers parsing old bare-id stdout must migrate to --output json.
